b1.ryoka_teaches_magnolia_ice_cream.rumor: Northern gossip says Lady Magnolia Reinhart has a new frozen sweet, a cold cream no one else can make yet.

canon_ref.note: Starts at the end of 1.26R: Ryoka reaches Celum in forty minutes and the package is ice cream. Same day as the Lich run. Delta is a design value.

b1.ryoka_teaches_magnolia_ice_cream.summary: The rush package is ice cream, and Ryoka lets slip that she knows it. She makes a custard in Magnolia's kitchen while a mage churns it frozen. Over tea, Magnolia and Ressa test her with Skills and a truth spell. Ryoka refuses all payment; Magnolia has someone look into her past.

b1.persua_crushes_ryokas_leg.rumor: Word from Celum: a City Runner was crushed under a wagon in a side street. Some Runners whisper it was no accident.

canon_ref.note: Late the same day, in Celum's streets. What glued her feet and knocked her down is not named (a spell or item). Deltas are design values.

b1.persua_crushes_ryokas_leg.summary: Leaving the mansion, Ryoka is boxed in by Claudeil, Toriska and about twenty Street Runners and herded into a side street. Persua trips her. Something sticky glues her feet, an unseen force knocks her flat, and a heavy mule wagon rolls over her leg.
